mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a policy response from the Fed, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with policy response expectation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the risk of recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 270.0 within one month signals accelerating inflation, increasing the probability of aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong underlying demand and supply chain resilience, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and INDPRO rise (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE declines in one month
regime_hint: labor market tightness with inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction effect Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, which increases the likelihood of fiscal and monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 declines for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
